title: The assistant's functions
description: Functions of the assistant that the basic catalog does not have. They are about the assistant and the page it runs in, not about components, so a surface still uses the basic catalog for its components. The page implements viewport itself; listWorkflows asks the assistant (callAgentFunction), so the page can show what a user may start.

viewport.description: The size of the page's window and its colour scheme, as an object {width, height, pixelRatio, colorScheme}: width and height in CSS pixels, colorScheme "light" or "dark". An agent may call it to fit what it shows to the screen.

listWorkflows.description: The workflows a user can start in a conversation, as a string such as "hello: Asks for a name. ui-demo: ..." (one entry per workflow). The page asks the assistant for it, so it is always the current list.
